sentences.text: Ms. Neelam Jain - Advocate for the appellants.
Shri A.N. Gupta - Government Advocate for the respond

Heard on I.A. No.6307/2025, which is an application filed under Section 389(I) of Cr.P.C./Section 430(1) of the Bharatiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, on behalf of appellant for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.

Appellant has been convicted under Section 376(2)(I) of IPC and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 10 years with fine of Rs.5,000/- and Section 3(2)(V) of SC/ST Act and sentenced to suffer Life Imprisonment with fine of Rs.5,000/- respectively, with default stipulations.
Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the age of the appellant at the time of incident was 75 years.
Now, he is above 83 years old.
The allegation against the appellant is of rape and he has already undergone above 9 years of incarceration.
He also submits that this appeal is of the year 2017 and would take time to be heard finally and as such, it is prayed that suspending the sentence awarded to appellant, he may be enlarged on bail.
On the other hand, learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer of bail.
Heard the submissions made by counsel for parties and perused the record.
Though, the medical reports regarding rape are found proved but considering the age of the appellant and actual custody, we are inclined to enlarge the appellant on bail.
Therefore, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

Accordingly, it is directed that the remaining jail sentence awarded to appellant shall remain suspended and he be released on bail subject to his depositing the amount of fine, if not already deposited, and on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/-(Rupees Fifty with a surety bond of like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for her appearance before the Registry of this Court on 16.12.2025 and on such other dates as may be fixed in this regard.
